thread:
Anna CSM: Quick health check — Marlin Health onboarding: p99 latency up ~15% since model v2.1 roll; customer has renewal conversation in 3 weeks. I'm proposing a proactive perf play: run an int8 quant canary + route 5% traffic to us-west kernel variant. Thoughts? :thinking:

Raj SE: +1 to a small canary. int8 usually gives ~30-40% token cost drop and latency win, but we should validate quality on their eval set first. Can we run evals against their prod prompt sample?

Mei Product: Agree. Need automated quality gate: run their top 200 prompts, compare ROUGE/BLEU-ish metrics we track (and a quick semantic-similarity smoke test). If delta <= 1.5% we can proceed.

Omar (Marlin Health): We noticed slower responses and a few malformed summaries last week. Happy to provide the prompt corpus — sending via email now. Main ask: keep clinical-summary accuracy > 98%.

Jules AE: Heads-up — renewal owner alerted. If we can show proactive ops and a safety plan, it helps the renewal conversation. Can we promise minimal risk?

Leo SRE: Canary plan suggestion:
- Create model variant: `redwood-m2.1-int8-usw`
- Route 5% of traffic with fallback to `m2.1` on quality/latency errors
- Monitor p50/p95/p99 + error rate and a small set of labeled checks
- Auto-rollback if p99 degrades > 10% or error rate > 0.5% for 10m

I'll add the circuit breaker and tracing.

Raj SE: Small code snippet for routing policy (mock):
```
routing_policy:
  - name: marlin-int8-canary
    match: customer.id == "marlin"
    buckets:
      - variant: m2.1-int8-usw
        weight: 5
      - variant: m2.1
        weight: 95
    fallback: m2.1
    rollback_condition:
      - metric: p99_latency
        comparator: ">"
        value: 1.10
```

Mei Product: Add a quality gate step after each 1000 tokens produced by canary. If semantic-similarity < 0.985 -> pause and notify CS + SE.

Anna CSM: Omar, once we get your prompt set I'll run the eval with Raj and post results here. Can we schedule a 20m quick call tomorrow to align on acceptance thresholds? @Omar (Marlin Health)

Omar (Marlin Health): Tomorrow 2pm PT works. Sending corpus now. Also: is there any perceptible change in token billing with int8?

Raj SE: Token billing is same per-token unit; you'll see cost drop on inference side (GPU time). We'll estimate before canary and share expected % cost reduction.

Jules AE: I'll join the call to take notes for renewal deck. If we can show projected cost/latency improvement + safety net, that's a win.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for `m2.1-int8-usw` -> 5% traffic at 3250009896 :rocket:

Leo SRE: Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood/monitor/marlin/3250009876 (private) — watching p99 and errors.

deploy-bot: Canary health: p50 -10%, p95 -18%, p99 -12%, error rate 0.03% (first 6m)

Raj SE: Initial eval on their sample (200 prompts): semantic-similarity 0.992, clinical-accuracy 99.1% — within thresholds.

Anna CSM: Superb. Next steps: 1) expand canary to 20% for 2h, 2) compile a one-pager for the renewal team showing numbers and rollback plan, 3) capture Marlin feedback post-2pm call. Who owns the one-pager?

Jules AE: I can draft the one-pager, Raj provide numbers and Leo add monitoring screenshots.

Omar (Marlin Health): After the call we'll also give a few real-user examples to validate hallucination risk. Appreciate the proactive move.

Anna CSM: Assigning tasks:
- Raj: run expanded perf/cost calc + attach eval artifacts (due EOD)
- Leo: observe 20% canary run and set auto-rollback thresholds (due before expansion)
- Jules: draft renewal one-pager (first draft in 24h)
- Mei: add gate to product playbook for future canaries

I'll capture all artifacts in the account folder.

Mei Product: Suggest we add this as a new entry in the proactive-ops playbook template: "quantization canary + routing fallback" with checklist.

Anna CSM: Thanks team. Great momentum — will post call notes and the eval result link here after 2pm. :thumbsup:
